card.title: Trust with a Trapdoor
card.instruction: Use one person as your anchor while preserving a private condition that could reverse your trust when a recurring detail returns.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my spare key. You're the only person I can leave the flat with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll feed the cat and make one tiny adjustment to those shelves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Actually, give it back. I'll cancel the trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The shelves stay exactly as they are. Even the crooked one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then keep it. You know his feeding times. Just send me a photo of him under that crooked shelf.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 relies exclusively on B, A3 withdraws without explaining the shelf trigger and A5 restores trust while covertly monitoring that detail.

heightening.evidence: B4 resolution restores dependence at A5 but the photo location keeps the private condition active.
